Could We Finally Be Getting The Long-Awaited Collaboration⁉️

Drakeo the Ruler, born Darrell Caldwell, was an influential Los Angeles rapper known for his unconventional flow, slick wordplay, and unique slang. Coming out of South Central Los Angeles, Drakeo helped create a distinct sound that influenced a new generation of West Coast artists. He was also closely associated with the Stinc Team, the rap collective and movement that included his brother Ralfy The Plug and other artists.

Drakeo built a major underground following through projects like Cold Devil, Thank You for Using GTL, and The Truth Hurts. His music reached an even wider audience through collaborations with artists including Drake, who appeared on “Talk to Me.” Drakeo passed away in December 2021 at age 28. His influence continues through his music, the Stinc Team movement, and artists who credit him as an inspiration.

Quavo, born Quavious Keyate Marshall, is an Atlanta rapper, songwriter, and performer best known as a member of Migos alongside Takeoff and Offset. Migos became one of the defining rap groups of the 2010s, breaking through nationally with “Versace” before scoring major hits such as “Bad and Boujee.”

Quavo has also built a successful solo career and collaborated with major artists across hip-hop and pop, including Drake, Travis Scott, Post Malone, Justin Bieber, and Young Thug. His connection with Ralfy The Plug is especially interesting for Drakeo fans because an unreleased Drakeo The Ruler x Quavo collaboration has been discussed, with Quavo reportedly giving Ralfy the green light to release the track.
